narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic skit using a pun on the phrase '奮不顧身' (reckless devotion) changed to 'Fan不顧聲' (fans regardless of their voice). The creator enters the room with a hoarse voice and explains it is because he went 'star chasing' (fandom activity), resulting in him losing his voice, thus being a devoted fan at the expense of his vocal cords.
